mLocKeys.keySummary: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for @RootDurationMin@ to @RootDurationMax@ seconds (based on distance travelled) and dealing @Damage@ magic damage.

The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by @AreaSlowAmount*100@% and deals @AreaDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The Slow and damage-over-time effects linger on enemies for a short duration after they've left the area created by the orb.

Deals @MinionModTooltip@ reduced damage when used against minions.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Mel has rooted this unit in place.
Mel is slowing and damaging the unit over time.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mel's Attacks and Abilities apply and refresh stacks of Overwhelm for @OverwhelmDuration@ seconds each time they deal damage, storing @spell.MelR:PassiveFlatDamage@ plus @spell.MelR:PassiveStackDamage@ damage per stack of magic damage. When applied, if the stored amount exceeds the enemy's combined shields and Health, they are executed.

When an Ability is cast, Mel's next Attack fires @PassiveBonusMissiles@ extra projectiles, each dealing @PassiveBonusMissileDamage@ magic damage. This effect can stack up to @MaxPassiveBonusMissiles@ extra projectiles.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Mel's Attacks and Abilities apply and refresh stacks of Overwhelm for @OverwhelmDuration@ seconds each time they deal damage, storing @spell.MelR:PassiveFlatDamage@ plus @spell.MelR:PassiveStackDamage@ damage per stack of magic damage. When applied, if the stored amount exceeds the enemy's combined shields and Health, they are executed.

When an Ability is cast, Mel's next Attack fires @PassiveBonusMissiles@ extra projectiles, each dealing @PassiveBonusMissileDamage@ magic damage. This effect can stack up to @MaxPassiveBonusMissiles@ extra projectiles.

Overwhelm deals @spell.MelR:FlatMinionMod*100@% damage with the first stack when used against minions.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Mel has recently cast making her next attack fire additional projectiles that deal magic damage.
This unit will be executed if struck by Mel at low Health. If Mel casts her Ultimate Ability, Golden Eclipse, this unit will be struck taking increased damage for each stack.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Mel unleashes a volley of projectiles that deal magic damage. Hitting an enemy champion reduces this ability's cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mel unleashes a barrage of @Count@ missiles that explode at the target location. The first time an enemy is struck, they take @InitialDamage@ magic damage, with subsequent hits dealing @SubsequentDamage@ magic damage each, for a maximum of @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

If the volley hits an enemy champion at least once, this ability's cooldown is reduced by @CDRefundChampHit@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to @PassiveFlatDamage@ magic damage plus @PassiveStackDamage@ magic damage per stack.

Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing @UltFlatDamage@ magic damage plus @UltStackDamage@ magic damage per Overwhelm stack.

Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Mel unleashes a refraction nova that destroys enemy projectiles it collides with, retaliating with magic missiles.

The nova also shields and grants move speed to Mel and her allies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mel unleashes a refraction nova that destroys enemy projectiles it collides with, retaliating for @InitialDamage@ magic damage. Subsequent retaliations against the same enemy deal @SubsequentDamage@ magic damage instead.

The nova also grants @TotalShield@ Shield and @TotalMS@ Move Speed for @BuffDuration@s to Mel and her allies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Cannot retaliate more than @MaxRetaliation@ times against each individual enemy</rules>
